proposition: According to Ibn Turka's second apology, Sultan Barqūq pressed him in a majlis for his opinion of another scholar, whom Melvin-Koushki identifies as Muḥammad al-Jazarī.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (1431-32), addressed to Bāysunghur
mediation.note: written to seek intercession from the ruler's son while his case was still unresolved
the identification of the scholar is MK's
